main_text.head: Cap. 8. De arte meditandi.
main_text.p: MEditatio sequitur, anima illa studiorum. Meditatio-nis I. Necessi-tas.Recte de ista Periander: μελέτη τὸ πᾶν [?]. Sicuti enim radii solares non calfaciunt, nisi reflexi atq; repercussi: ita ingenium non valet, nisi intendatur, nisi intellectus se reflectat. Ubi ergo lectioni, studio, conversationi, accessit meditatio, & vicissim meditationi facultas, facultati tandem succedit eloquentia. Nam
Rem bene prævisam verba haut invita sequentur.

p.i: Etenim vis hac cogitandi una & sola est ratio percipiendi, quae oratione proferas, & proferendi, quae ante animo perceperis.

main_text.p: Modus meditationis ita à nobis est colle-2. Modus.ctus ex aliquam multis locis apud Ciceronem.

page.notes: The Greek phrase "μελέτη τὸ πᾶν" is uncertain; the accents and letters were not clearly legible at this resolution. The lines "uti enim radii solares non calfaciunt, nisi reflexi atq; repercussi: ita ingenium non valet, nisi intendatur, nisi intellectus se reflectat" are printed in italic but struck through in the scan. They are transcribed as printed. The ornamental rule above "Cap. 8." and the ornament at the start of "Minutis" are decoration, not text. "Ars meditandi." and "2. Modus." are margin notes at the right. The marginal note "Meditatio-nis / I. Necessi-tas." is split across four lines and transcribed as one note. "prævisam" is printed with the æ ligature; u/v is normalised to v.
